ns2:course.label: Individual Study
ns2:course.description: Readings in selected philosophical topics. Course may be taken by honors students in partial fulfillment of department honors requirements. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Open to juniors and seniors with a grade-point average of 3.0 only by prior arrangement with a regular member of the staff and with consent of the department chair.
